frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: INTRUDER DETECTED. SCANNING... GREETINGS SPECIMEN. I AM DIODE, GUARDIAN OF COMPLEX 0x2A.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Hello Diode! Your planet looks beautiful, but what happened to it?

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body:
PLANET: ELECTRONOVA. STATUS: SILENT.
ELECTRONOVA ONCED THRIVED WITH THE ENERGY OF TECHNO MUSIC. DIODES AND FUSEONS WORKED TOGETHER TO POWER THE BEATS. BUT THE GRAND COMPOSER'S INTERFERENCE JAMMED OUR SIGNAL AND SHORTED OUR CIRCUITS, LEAVING ELECTRONOVA IN PERPETUAL SILENCE.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Don't worry Diode, I'm here to restore your harmony. I rode the great wave from Harmonious, and Monad told me I might find parts here to repair my ship.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: YOUR MISSION ALIGNS WITH OUR NEEDS. MOTHER BOARD WILL PROVIDE THE PARTS YOU REQUIRE.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Great! Where can I find this Mother Board?

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: MOTHER BOARD IS LOCATED IN THE CENTRAL HUB, BUT HER CIRCUITS ARE DORMANT. YOU MUST MEND HER BROKEN RHYTHM CORE, A TASK THAT ONLY THE BEST TECHNO JAMMERS CAN ACCOMPLISH.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Sounds like a challenge, but I'm ready. Where is the Rhythm Core?

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: THE RHYTHM CORE IS GUARDED BY THE FUSEON SENTINELS. THEIR POSITION IS WRITTEN ON MY LOCATOR CHIP. BUT IT REQUIRES A BLAST OF TECHNO POWER TO JUMPSTART.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Stand still Diode, I can handle this.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Player! A new symbol has appeared on the system!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: When the beat appears, raise your index finger to the sky!
